idea-plugin.name: Branch Health Dashboard
idea-plugin.description:
Branch Health Dashboard

Stop guessing which branches need attention. Branch Health Dashboard gives every Git branch a health score from 0 to 100, predicts merge conflicts before they happen, and recommends optimal merge strategies — all in a single tool window.

Key Features

  • Health Scoring (0–100) — Composite score based on age, activity, divergence, and conflicts
  • Stale Branch Detection — Identify and clean up abandoned branches automatically
  • Conflict Prediction — Proactive warnings when branches are heading toward merge conflicts
  • Merge Strategy Advisor — Recommends rebase vs. merge based on branch topology
  • Activity Tracking — Visualize commit frequency and recency per branch
  • Notifications — Alerts when branch health drops below configured thresholds

Why Branch Health Dashboard?

Long-lived branches are a top source of integration pain. This plugin gives teams visibility into branch health and actionable guidance to keep Git workflows clean.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Health score, age tracking, activity analysis for up to 5 branches
  • Pro: Unlimited branches, conflict prediction, rebase advisor, auto-cleanup rules, team notifications, and branch policy enforcement
